title: Stinkyscape+ Balance Changes VI: the Smoothie filling posts no event
notes: A Smoothie that gains its Fruits' text (R4440006) posted an in-place `transformed` as it filled; with the pools rotated (the pool probe), Radiant Call to Chaos's five random Fruits could hold a Smoothie, whose event broke R423's order. The filling posts nothing now: the card stays where it is as it was, and its owner's view already shows the text it runs. The cards that can put a Smoothie in a hand play differently in their event logs alone.

player.title: Smoothie fix
fixes: A Smoothie no longer sends a hidden card-change notice as it fills with its Fruits.
